Login with Invalid Credentials: There is no server-routable /login URL — Uptime Kuma is a single-page app with no SPA history-mode fallback on the server, so a direct/hard page.goto('/login') 404s. The login form only appears via a client-side redirect: navigate to an auth-required route instead (e.g. page.goto('/dashboard')) while unauthenticated, and the app redirects in-browser and updates the URL bar to /login itself. Use /dashboard (not /login) to REACH the login form; asserting the resulting URL against /\/login/ is still correct, since that part of the redirect is real.
